notes.title: VariDungeon 0.10.0: Bloody Hell
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/bda6d1e98289e5f7810bc1e3b3d9ceb77b875ff1.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Patch 0.10.0 (Bloody Hell):[/b][/h2][p][b]New Biome:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The Hell,[/b] unlocked by getting 4 runes in one run, a portal appears[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New playable character:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The Cards Master[/b]: throws two cards diagonally, and he can make them spin as well. This character can not get any power up, but has the ingot bonus (more golds equals more damage), and gets twice as many runes as the others characters, and they don't give any negative effect[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/30fff69e2da35d92eb5c0c5449ddf1213cc564da.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]New enemies:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Cultist[/b]: runs away from the player, teleports if the player is close and spawns bats[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moon Slime[/b]: spawns falling meteors and runs away from the player in the meantime[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weeping Angel[/b]: applies a blindness effect, teleports and runs away[/p][/*][*][p]New Boss, [b]the Vampire[/b]: Runs on the player, applies blindness, spawns tornadoes, meteors and bats, clones himself...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/eaf5ace249484855b85a675612aa43c0d2e4f1ee.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Achievements[/b] are back[/p][/*][*][p]New mechanic: [b]Runes[/b] appears on the walls. You can accept to lower one of your stats to increase another one[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/279cd601fa128b2ace4f5b7050f6a7fb801c3e31.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Luck Clovers[/b]: Found in the pots, they increase your chances of looting XP, coins, shields from breakables and enemies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stats menu[/b] to see your build in details[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/7c7480e2202b5edafd79e4922ce6078c61c8d536.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Music:[/b][/p][list][*][p]3 new [b]music tracks[/b] (Hell exploration, Hell combat and Hell boss)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nerfed the [b]damage bonus[/b] (20% -> 10%)[/p][/*][*][p]Nerfed the [b]damage sphere talent[/b] (10% -> 5%)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Engine:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Code optimization[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of life:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Attacks can touch enemies after their period of invincibility[/p][/*][*][p]Stats menu in the runes menu[/p][/*][*][p]The B button does not close the home menu anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Shiny effect on chests[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping animation added on some enemies[/p][/*][*][p]PC language used for default language[/p][/*][*][p]Mage character: hold button to automatically throw fireballs[/p][/*][*][p]Afterimage on projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Better placement for the crosses on the ground[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the build number[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a graphical glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on the meteors placement[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: VariDungeon 0.9.0: Remake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/1ae1c7ec9d659689a056fa26662eaebc9f032e67.png[/img]
New major update: [b]VariDungeon has been remade![/b]

- The [b]whole previously playable game and content [/b](from expansions 0.1.0 to 0.8.0) have been remade using a freshly [b]home-made game engine[/b],
- [b]Improved in-game feedback and feeling[/b]: more animations, items are directly going to the player, explosion on level up, attack indicator on enemies and many more...,
- [b]Build limit:[/b] 2 active, 3 passive,
- [b]New in-game bonus:[/b] mini fireball, ingot, lense, mega laser, electrical orb,
- [b]New secrets[/b] (no spoil, play and see!),
- [b]New difficulty choices[/b] to customize your runs,
- Various [b]new music tracks[/b],

To be added in the next patch: FR and ES translation, Steam achievements, save on Steam Cloud, Linux version

notes.title: VariDungeon 0.8.0: Six Leagues Under

This new major update features :
- new optional cave biome with a new ending if you find the right NPC...

notes.title: VariDungeon 0.6.0: Shadow Realm
notes.content:
Introducing the new update to VariDungeon : Shadow Realm !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/2cc3a687cb2aafef3f444c56dd462b9e20233380.png[/img]

This [b]major update[/b] contains :
- new biome : shadow realm, found between the boss rush and the true last boss

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/f07cd7a1d65aacb50eca4add88f357167a916fdd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/1ec67580e295902777bfbb4450c9cc0dd5ae9546.png[/img][/url]
- a [b]new playable character[/b] : the [b]Necromancer[/b], who can summon a minion and make it evolve to level 3
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/9df88916159276b8dbd57dd01240d1103776a138.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/2c2258059448aacc0810af6708639af68014f2e4.png[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/a58ff57ffdd9603768cd98d09d3cc72aa538e1a9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/2ec4314a53fea7117e6da5c25bc4d91c3c21ad1e.png[/img][/url]
- a [b]new trap[/b]
- a [b]new drop[/b] in breakable elements : [b]shields[/b], which will absorb 1 damage
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/6b988dafd14c1956c3788e2f2f80ab18b9a3e04e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/c8abcb4747552f029466de3e1f874928b087fb8e.png[/img][/url]

- [b]challenge rooms[/b] : in these rooms, defeat 3 waves of monsters to get a reward
- [b]new achievements[/b]

Have fun on the 0.6 !

notes.content:

This update features global balance, game structure and comfort changes :
- the merchant is now between the 2nd and 3rd floors and the 4th and final boss floors

notes.title: VariDungeon 0.3.0: Knights and Portals
notes.content:
This update adds new [b]tower portals containing portals[/b]. The doors are replaced by portals in the corners of each room so try not to get lost in the dungeon ! 
These new floors feature :
- a new playable character : the [b]Paladin[/b], which uses his book to cast spells around him and heal himself
- 9 new [b]enemies[/b]
- 2 new [b]bosses[/b]
- 30 new [b]rooms[/b]
- a new [b]trap[/b]
- 3 new [b]power-ups[/b]

In addition to this, the game now features [b]a map of the current floor[/b] !
We also made [b]lots of balance changes on the previous enemies[/b] (stats changes, visual indication before they attack, ...)

Have fun !

notes.title: We are back !
notes.content:
We are back !

A [b]new minor update[/b] is available.
This update adds [b]new achievements[/b] and [b]new music tracks[/b] for the ice biome ! Will you find them all ?
At the moment, we are working on the [b]next major update[/b] and a [b]new home-made game engine[/b] to improve the performance of the game.
Stay tuned and have fun !

PS : Here is a [b]hint[/b] for the theme of the next major update !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/fbad41097a56ea5e7c22074ad1e2916e54fbbf2c.png[/img]

notes.title: VariDungeon: Ice and Mages
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/d6c79e4e170021c97513178f2176650147e14a29.png[/img]
This update adds new [b]ice floors[/b] in the dungeon featuring new elements such as :
- 7 new [b]enemies[/b]
- 3 new [b]bosses[/b]
- new [b]traps [/b]and [b]power-ups[/b]

There is also a new [b]playable characte[/b]r : [b]the Mage[/b] ! Throw fire balls and use your shield wisely to defeat all the dangers in the dungeon...

This update also adds [b]special floors[/b] in which you have to find a key to enter in the boss room, and a [b]hard mode[/b] ! In this extreme mode, you have to reach the end of the dungeon starting with only two hearts !

notes.title: Varidungeon on Linux and Steam Deck !
notes.content:
[h1][b]Varidungeon on Linux and Steam Deck ![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047894/27547acb7a2b143360116f0b59115c15fbefe25d.png[/img]
Besides Windows and MacOS, [b]Varidungeon[/b] is now available on every [b]Linux distribution[/b] ! If you are into [b]open-source OS[/b] or use a [b]Steam Deck[/b], you can now play our game !
